jobs.title: Vice President, Project & Program Management
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Vice President, Project & Program Management to lead business growth, client engagement, operational performance, and delivery of complex capital programs and projects across the New York metropolitan area. The role will focus primarily on public agency clients, with private-sector relationships and experience considered a strong advantage.
Position Responsibilities:
- Provide executive leadership for AECOM’s New York Program and Project Management business, balancing market growth, client service, project delivery, financial performance, and staff development.
- Build a culture of leadership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and professional development through active coaching and mentoring.
- Drive profitable, collaborative growth of Program Management and Construction Management services across infrastructure, transportation, buildings, aviation, water, housing, education, and other capital markets.
- Coordinate portfolio priorities, staffing plans, work-sharing, and resource assignments to provide clients with the appropriate expertise at the appropriate time.
- Lead and support multidisciplinary teams throughout planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
- Develop and implement Program Management Plans, Project Execution Plans, governance structures, decision frameworks, and delivery procedures.
- Oversee project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, safety, commercial performance, and client satisfaction across multiple concurrent assignments.
- Promote consistent project delivery practices, including work planning, monthly project reviews, forecasting, corrective action, and lessons learned.
- Oversee operating budgets and portfolio performance in coordination with business line leadership.
- Recruit, develop, engage, and retain high-performing staff; support succession planning and leadership development across the practice.
- Lead a sizable team through direct and indirect supervision and collaborate across AECOM offices, business lines, and technical disciplines.
- Perform other responsibilities consistent with the role and business needs.

Business Development & Market Leadership:
- Develop and execute the New York market strategy for Program and Project Management services in alignment with AECOM business priorities.
- Lead client discovery, capture planning, strategic pursuits, proposals, interviews, and negotiations for major opportunities.
- Identify and advance new opportunities with existing and prospective clients, including alternative delivery, PMO, program controls, owner’s representative, and construction management assignments.
- Contribute to account planning, pipeline development, go/no-go decisions, teaming strategies, and growth forecasts.
- Maintain strong industry visibility and represent AECOM in client meetings, presentations, professional associations, and public forums.
- Build relationships with private-sector owners and developers to complement the practice’s core public-sector portfolio.

Client and Team Leadership:
- Serve as an executive sponsor, trusted advisor, and senior point of contact for agency and client leadership.
- Establish and maintain productive relationships with executives, stakeholders, consultants, contractors, community representatives, and regulatory agencies.
- Provide strategic guidance regarding delivery strategy, procurement, governance, organizational readiness, risk, schedule, cost, and stakeholder alignment.
- Anticipate client needs, resolve escalated issues, and ensure commitments are met with responsive, high-quality service.
- Client-focused executive who builds trust and converts relationships into long-term partnerships.
- Growth-oriented leader who connects market strategy, pursuit discipline, operational execution, and financial performance.
- Collaborative people leader who develops talent and mobilizes resources across a matrixed organization.
- Decisive program leader who can navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive successful outcomes.

Client Experience:  Public and Private
- New York City agencies and authorities, including DDC, SCA, NYCHA, DEP, DOT, EDC, and other mayoral agencies.
- Regional and state entities, including the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, DASNY, and New York State agencies.
- Federal agencies and other public authorities responsible for complex capital programs.
- Real estate developers and commercial or mixed-use owners.
- Higher education and healthcare institutions.
- Aviation and transportation operators.
- Data center, corporate campus, and major infrastructure developers.
Minimum Qualifications:
- BA/BS in engineering, construction management, architecture, or a closely related discipline plus 12 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership
- 15 plus years of relevant experience in program management, project management, construction management, design management, or capital program delivery.
- Demonstrated leadership of large, complex, multidisciplinary capital projects or programs in the New York metropolitan market.
- Professional Engineer (PE), Registered Architect (RA), Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM), or DBIA certification.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business administration, or a related field.
- 15 or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least 6 years of supervisory or business leadership experience.
- Proven experience with business development, client relationship management, pursuit leadership, team building, and financial performance.
- Working knowledge of public-sector procurement, contracting, capital planning, project controls, risk management, design and construction delivery, and regulatory coordination.
- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, decision-making, and relationship-management skills.
- Experience leading major programs using design-bid-build, design-build, construction management, progressive design-build, or other alternative delivery methods.
- Established relationships within the New York capital programs market.
- Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
- Relocation is not available now or in the future.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Environmental Remediation
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a strategic, results-driven Remediation Program Manager with deep expertise in environmental assessment and remediation for Oil and Gas clients operating in Colorodo, Texas or California. This role leads complex programs across upstream, midstream, and downstream assets, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance and stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will bring a nuanced understanding of state-specific environmental regulations and technical delivery excellence and will manage a team of remediation professionals.  The candidate can be located in either the Southern California area (LA to San Diego) or Northern California (Sacramento, San Fran, Oakland area) or Texas Area specifically (Midland, or Houston).
Project Delivery
- Drives program performance to meet and/or exceed client satisfaction and KPIs

- Drives business performance and the attainment and exceedance of internal KPIs

- Interacts with Governance & Risk Leader to ensure any service issues are identified and addressed in a proactive manner

- Develops and formulates solutions to client problems/issues

- Participates in project reviews of major program/project dashboards/deep dives to identify issues and improve performance

- Works to drive adoption of digital tools

- Actively integrates global resources into local delivery and manages the change associated with this transition

- Directly manages projects

People Leadership
- Act as direct supervisor for a team of remediation professionals

- Serves as a focal point for major issue resolution, and provides rapid follow-up to address concerns

- Participates in feedback for Project Managers to assure client satisfaction and long-term growth

- Develops and implements succession plan for the program team and advises on the recruiting of key people to serve client needs

- Assures that project delivery employees working on major programs are trained and mentored with a long-term goal of training new program managers

Business Development
- Works collaboratively with Client Account Managers and Environmental Business Line Leadership to grow profitable backlog and ensure the financial success of their respective client program

- Builds, maintains, and facilitates trusting relationships with key contacts across the depth and breadth of client organizations

- Develops budgets that allow for business development portfolio management, tracking & optimizing wins and bookings, and project oversight

- Leads capture strategies for key pursuits and major projects within the program, ensures those strategies yield high capture rates, grows the business and relevant technical capabilities
Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field AND (10) ten years of experience or a demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership positions.

- The successful candidate will be subject to a background check and a motor vehicle records check.

- Due to the nature of the role, US Citizenship or permanent residency is required.  Sponsorship for this role now and in the future will not be available.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Geoscience, or related discipline

- P.G. or P.E. Licensed in California or Colorado, or Texas

- (10) Ten years of experience within the environmental consulting industry, and (5) Five years focused on Oil and Gas clients in California, Colorado, or Texas.

- Experienced people manager and team builder

- Proven track record in managing environmental programs under California’s, Colorodo's, or Texas' regulatory frameworks

- Experienced communicator and team leader with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders

- Resilient, adaptable, and collaborative in high-pressure environments

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Water Business Line
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the water industry? AECOM’s Water Business Line is on the lookout for a  dynamic and accomplished strategic leader  with bold ideas to join our leadership team in one of our New England offices! This is an exciting opportunity to shape meaningful water accounts and drive our regional growth in the  drinking water, wastewater, conveyance, and water resources markets .
As a Senior Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing a  multi-year, multi-project capital improvement program (CIP)  exceeding  $2 billion  for a municipal or regional water/wastewater utility. You will establish and lead a  Program Management Office (PMO) , providing executive-level stakeholder leadership and driving delivery outcomes across key areas such as schedule, cost, risk, quality, safety, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
You will oversee the full program lifecycle—from planning through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover—across complex infrastructure portfolios including treatment facilities, conveyance systems, reservoirs, CSO programs, resilience initiatives, and digital/asset systems .
This position offers a unique chance to work within an established and successful group that boasts a diverse range of technical proficiencies and abundant career development opportunities. You’ll be client-facing, managing meaningful accounts that will contribute to our ambitious growth plans.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and Inspire – Build and lead a high-performing PMO with best-in-class governance, controls, reporting, and performance metrics for a multi-billion-dollar CIP.
- Drive Program Excellence – Implement and oversee program controls including cost, schedule, risk, change management, and document control, ensuring accurate forecasting and accountability.
- Strategic Advisor – Guide clients on delivery models (DBB, CMAR, DB, Progressive DB) and lead procurement strategy and execution.
- Compliance & Stewardship – Oversee regulatory compliance (EPA, state agencies), permitting, and consent decree/enforcement obligations.
- Shape Sustainable Outcomes – Integrate resilience, sustainability, equity, and lifecycle asset strategies into program decisions and prioritization.
- Deliver End-to-End Programs – Lead design management, value engineering, constructability reviews, commissioning, and operational turnover.
- Proactively Manage Risk – Drive risk identification, analysis, mitigation planning, and governance across the program lifecycle.
- Build High-Performing Teams – Attract, mentor, and develop diverse talent; manage subconsultants and contractors; foster a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Communicate with Impact – Establish executive dashboards and reporting frameworks; ensure transparency and effective issue escalation.
- Strengthen Client Relationships – Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders including utilities, agencies, community leaders, and partners.
- Innovate for Performance – Identify and implement digital tools and new technologies to enhance program delivery and outcomes.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
- BA/BS in Engineering, Construction Management or related field + 10 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- 4+ years of experience in leadership roles.
- Proven experience managing large-scale infrastructure programs, including scope, budget, and schedule oversight
- Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
- Experience working in a digital, paperless project environment
- Due to the nature of work, U.S. Citizenship is required.

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS:
- Master's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related field
- Professional Engineer (PE) license in New England states or ability to obtain within 4 months
- Demonstrated success leading complex water/wastewater capital programs
- Experience with program controls and digital platforms (e.g., Primavera P6, Power BI, cost/risk systems)
- Passion for innovation, sustainability, and advancing resilient infrastructure solutions
- Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
- Relocation is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Consultant Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior Digital Consultant for the Digital Consulting workstream to support the growth of a new regional and global digital service.
As a Digital Consultant you will have a key role in guiding our client organisations through the advisory and implementation of digital strategies, data analytics, AI adoption, technology and product development. The main objective will be to provide comprehensive end-to-end customer support, facilitating the integration of digital solutions into their business operations. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely with clients, understanding their business goals, evaluating current digital capabilities, and formulating strategies to drive measurable business outcomes through digital methods. As a key player in executing our digital strategy for growth, you will support digital teams and consultancy delivery for our key clients, contributing to the expansion of our services, including revenue, margin, and net promoter score.
About Digital @AECOM
As a member of the Europe digital community, you will work with leaders from around the world to define and position digital consulting services, to share best practices, to leverage global capabilities and to support opportunities and projects.
Key Responsibilities:
Client Delivery
- Working with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities, helping them to navigate the digital era
- Support the development and building of client relationships through client-facing project work, collaboration workshops, pitches and showcases of digital offerings
- Exploiting data and technologies to enable the client to coordinate activities and realise value from their assets.
- Conduct assessments of current digital processes and capabilities across the relevant functions and asset classes within the client organisation
- Identify and prioritise digital initiatives that deliver maximum value and impact.
- Support the development and implementation of robust Information Management practices to ensure project data is structured, governed, and leveraged effectively across client organisations
- Apply effective Change Management principles to guide teams through digital adoption, ensuring smooth transitions and sustained engagement across projects
- Supporting the design and implementation of appropriate information security controls
- Project management support of consultancy commissions, including cost, risk & schedule
- Leading client workshops using known methods e.g. Design Thinking, and facilitation tools e.g. Miro

Internal Delivery
- Connecting with the Work Winning community and Client Account Managers on consultancy leads and tender opportunities and supporting wider strategic bids
- Supporting pre-qualification, tender responses, proposals and case studies
- Promoting and supporting development of digital service offerings internally
- Creating, showcasing case studies and thought leadership
- Commoditizing consultancy deliverables as repeatable offerings
- Lessons learned – feeding knowledge from commissions back into the business to support future growth and opportunities
- Supporting research on digital innovation – new technologies, processes, and start-ups to identify opportunities
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of digital solutions
- Demonstrated ability to support delivery of strategic consultancy commissions
- Demonstrated ability to combine Asset Management, Project Management, Information Management and data skills to deliver digital projects in the infrastructure sector
- Experience in working with technical and non technical analytics teams
- Experience of influencing non-technical executive stakeholders from around the business
- Experience in supporting business development, customer acquisition and retention.

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. jobs.description:
Job Description
Join AECOM’s Transportation team in Atlanta and play a key leadership role in delivering complex transportation programs across Georgia. As a Roadway Program Manager , you will provide strategic oversight of roadway programs and multidisciplinary teams, ensuring successful delivery of client objectives, operational excellence, and long-term program performance. This position offers a hybrid work option.
The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:
- Providing overall program leadership and oversight for roadway design contracts and transportation programs.
- Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, fostering trusted relationships and supporting long-term business objectives.
- Managing program-level scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and performance across multiple concurrent projects.
- Coordinating multidisciplinary teams and resources to ensure consistent, efficient, and successful project delivery.
- Monitoring program performance metrics and implementing strategies to improve delivery, quality, and client satisfaction.
- Leading project managers and technical leads in the execution of roadway, drainage, traffic, right-of-way, utility coordination, and construction support services.
- Supporting business development efforts, including capture planning, proposal development, contract negotiations, and client engagement.
- Identifying and mitigating program risks while proactively managing change and stakeholder expectations.
- Driving implementation of quality management processes and continuous improvement initiatives across the program.
- Mentoring project managers and technical staff to support leadership development, succession planning, and workforce growth.
- Collaborating with regional and national leadership to align program execution with strategic business goals.
Minimum :
- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or related discipline and 8 years of related experience, including roadway project delivery and leadership responsibilities, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Georgia PE License.

Preferred:
- Fifteen years of experience managing transportation programs and roadway design projects.
- Experience serving as Program Manager or Deputy Program Manager on GDOT contracts.
- Experience working on GDOT Alternative Delivery Projects
- Experience managing on-call contracts, task order programs, or large transportation design programs.
- Strong understanding of GDOT policies, procedures, and plan development processes.
- Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing client relationships.

jobs.title: Site Strategy Manager, Data Center Sites - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a  Program Manager for Data Center Site Strategy and Portfolio Development  with a passion for driving results to join our high-performance data center team.  In this role, the program manager will plan, direct, and execute multiple moderate-to-large scale projects and programs to support the utility and land development for next-generation digital infrastructure.  This role has a strong focus on site development planning for data centers.
This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.
While this position is eligible for remote work, office attendance is encouraged if an AECOM office is proximal. Periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.
AECOM  is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.
Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and lead cross-functional teams, including engineers, planners, and consultants; including recruitment and “care and feeding” of direct reports.
- Build trust with the client, local communities and regulatory and economic development entities.
- Support identification and evaluation of land opportunities aligned with long-term data center growth.
- Accountable for the overall results of a project or groups of projects, including goal setting, team leadership and adherence to internal and external budgets and schedules.
- Performs various management, leadership and people accountability responsibilities for a specific technical group or department.
- Drive to completion due diligence, zoning, permitting, entitlement, and offsite infrastructure processes.
- Proactively identify and deliver risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
- Reinforce a culture of accountability, innovation, and open communication.
- Train and deploy machine-learning based program and project management and delivery platforms (AECOM’s AI4Eng).
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, Urban Planning, or related field plus 8 years of experience in land development, infrastructure, or project management or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Demonstrated experience with colocation and hyperscale data center projects.

Preferred Qualifications
- Licensed Professional Engineer, Architect, or Land Planner
- Advanced degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, Urban Planning
- 12 or more years of experience in general land development, infrastructure, or project management.
- Proficient with data center operations and site development and construction processes.
- Demonstrated ability to support large-scale initiatives and cross-functional teams.
- Proficiency conducting feasibility studies and evaluating potential sites for development.
- Knowledge of environmental assessments, zoning regulations, land use planning, and utility infrastructure portfolios.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Desired Attributes:
- Proficiency with digital geospatial, project and program management, and machine learning platforms.
- Excellent verbal and written communication for stakeholder presentations and reporting.
- Experience in managing client relationships and understanding their business needs.
- Skilled communicator with emotional intelligence and adaptability.
- Growth-oriented mindset
- Proven ability to work under pressure in fast-paced environments
- Ability to manage complex logistics and team dynamics.
- Collaborative mindset with a bias for action and problem-solving

- Demonstrated ability to support large-scale initiatives and cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Remediation Program Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM seeks a strategic, results-driven Remediation Program Manager with deep expertise in environmental assessment and remediation for Oil and Gas clients  in Colorado. This role leads complex programs across upstream, midstream, and downstream assets, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance and stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will bring a nuanced understanding of state-specific environmental regulations and technical delivery excellence and will manage a team of remediation professionals.
Project Delivery
- Drives program performance to meet and/or exceed client satisfaction and KPIs
- Drives business performance and the attainment and exceedance of internal KPIs
- Interacts with Governance & Risk Leader to ensure any service issues are identified and addressed in a proactive manner
- Develops and formulates solutions to client problems/issues
- Participates in project reviews of major program/project dashboards/deep dives to identify issues and improve performance
- Works to drive adoption of digital tools
- Actively integrates global resources into local delivery and manages the change associated with this transition
- Directly manages projects

People Leadership
- Act as direct supervisor for a team of remediation professionals
- Serves as a focal point for major issue resolution, and provides rapid follow-up to address concerns
- Participates in feedback for Project Managers to assure client satisfaction and long-term growth
- Develops and implements a succession plan for the program team and advises on the recruiting of key people to serve client needs
- Assures that project delivery employees working on major programs are trained and mentored with a long-term goal of training new program managers

Business Development

- Works collaboratively with Client Account Managers and Environmental Business Line Leadership to grow profitable backlog and ensure the financial success of their respective client program
- Builds, maintains, and facilitates trusting relationships with key contacts across the depth and breadth of client organizations
- Develops budgets that allow for business development portfolio management, tracking & optimizing wins and bookings, and project oversight
- Leads capture strategies for key pursuits and major projects within the program, ensures those strategies yield high capture rates, grows the business and relevant technical capabilities
Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, engineering, or related field AND (8) eight years of experience or a demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- The successful candidate will be subject to a background check
- A valid driver’s license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy
- Due to the nature of the role, US Citizenship or permanent residency is required.  Sponsorship for this role now and in the future will not be available.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in environmental engineering, geoscience, or related discipline
- P.G. or P.E. Licensed in California or Colorado, or Texas
- (10) Ten years of experience within the environmental consulting industry, and (5) Five years focused on Oil and Gas clients in California, Colorado, or Texas.
- Experienced people manager and team builder
- Proven track record in managing environmental programs under California’s, Colorado's, or Texas' regulatory frameworks
- Experienced communicator and team leader with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders
- Resilient, adaptable, and collaborative in high-pressure environments
- Sponsorship for this role now and in the future will not be available.
- Relocation for this role will not be available.

jobs.title: Sr. Mining Program Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a talented and experienced  Mining Program Manager  for our growing Mining team in Lima, Peru.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Manage multi-disciplined engineering and project delivery teams, including a hybrid blend of in-person and remote team members.
- Demonstrate creativity, foresight and mature judgment in anticipating and solving both routine and unusual project delivery, technical and client challenges, determining technical objectives and requirements, organizing programs and projects.
- Manage and monitor contractual obligations for engineering projects of various sizes and complexities.
- Prepare project and engineering work plans, budgets, schedules for studies, detailed design, and construction support.
- Monitor project cost, schedule, and quality performance, and take corrective action as necessary.
- Lead project meetings, ensure timely delivery of minutes, and drive meeting efficiency and effective outcomes.
- Supervise discipline resources and/or assist in the preparation of deliverables and products such as presentation materials, calculations, drawings, specifications, and cost estimates related to mining and industrial site infrastructure, port infrastructure, materials handling systems, process residue waste management and mechanical services.

jobs.title: Program Management Director, Rail & Transit
jobs.description:
The Program Director – Rail and Transit is the senior leader responsible for the overall strategy, governance, delivery, and successful outcomes of large, complex rail and transit programs. The role provides executive leadership across all phases of the program lifecycle, from pursuit and mobilization through delivery, commissioning, and operational readiness.
The Program Director establishes the vision and delivery framework for major rail infrastructure investments, ensuring alignment with client objectives, rail industry regulations, public expectations, and organizational priorities. The role oversees multidisciplinary teams spanning engineering, systems integration, construction, operations, commercial management, environmental compliance, and stakeholder engagement.
As the accountable executive for program performance, the Program Director drives safety excellence, operational reliability, digital innovation, and sustainable delivery while maintaining focus on schedule, budget, quality, and long-term asset performance. The role also serves as a key industry leader, strengthening client relationships, supporting strategic growth initiatives, and enhancing organizational capability within the rail sector.
The role has been established to strengthen leadership readiness for major rail pursuits and support succession planning across strategic rail programs, ensuring experienced leadership is available to transition seamlessly from bid through delivery and operational commencement.
Due to the nature of the role, initial work location may be flexible; however, relocation to a major rail program location may be required following program award.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Program Leadership
- Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for major rail and transit programs, ensuring successful achievement of client, regulatory, operational, and business objectives.
- Establish and maintain an integrated program management framework covering engineering, construction, systems, testing and commissioning, and operational readiness.
- Define delivery strategies, governance structures, and performance objectives that support successful program outcomes and long-term network benefits.
- Lead program mobilization activities, ensuring the organization, systems, resources, and leadership structures are in place for successful execution.

Rail Systems & Operations Integration
- Oversee integration across all rail disciplines including track, signaling, communications, traction power, overhead catenary systems, stations, depots, rolling stock interfaces, and operational systems.
- Ensure effective systems integration and interface management across contractors, suppliers, operators, maintainers, and government stakeholders.
- Provide leadership during testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover activities to achieve safe and successful railway operations.
- Guide implementation of asset management, maintainability, reliability, and operational performance requirements throughout delivery.

Safety & Regulatory Compliance
- Serve as the senior safety leader for the program, promoting a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure compliance with all rail regulatory requirements, industry standards, safety certification processes, and client governance expectations.
- Oversee program-wide risk management, assurance, environmental stewardship, and quality programs.
- Support achievement of safety approvals, regulatory certifications, operational permits, and authorization processes required for service commencement.

Client & Stakeholder Leadership
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client executives, rail operators, government agencies, regulators, funding bodies, and community stakeholders.
- Represent the program at executive steering committees, governance boards, industry forums, and public stakeholder engagements.
- Resolve complex stakeholder issues and drive alignment across diverse interests while protecting program objectives.

Commercial & Financial Management
- Provide executive oversight of program commercial strategy, contract administration, claims resolution, procurement, and supplier performance.
- Ensure effective management of program budgets, forecasts, contingencies, and financial performance.
- Direct commercial negotiations and strategic decision-making related to major contracts, partnerships, and delivery arrangements.
- Monitor program performance and implement corrective actions to manage cost, schedule, risk, and opportunity.

Innovation & Capability Development
- Champion innovation, digital delivery, BIM, digital engineering, data analytics, and emerging rail technologies.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program performance, efficiency, and client value.
- Mentor and develop senior program leaders, supporting succession planning and workforce capability growth within the rail sector.
- Contribute to pursuit strategies, bid development, and market growth initiatives across rail and transit portfolios.
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Program Management, Transportation, Business, or a related field.
- Typically 20+ years of experience in infrastructure delivery, including significant leadership experience on major rail, transit, or transportation programs.
- Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-billion-dollar rail infrastructure programs involving multiple stakeholders and delivery partners.
- Deep understanding of rail systems, infrastructure delivery models, regulatory environments, and operational requirements.
- Professional certification such as PgMP, PMP, APM RPP, CCM, or equivalent preferred.
- Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or equivalent professional registration preferred.

Preferred Experience
- Executive leadership of major passenger rail, high-speed rail, metro, light rail, commuter rail, freight rail, or transit programs.
- Experience delivering programs involving significant rail systems integration, testing and commissioning, and operational readiness.
- Successful engagement with rail regulators, operators, infrastructure managers, and government agencies.
- Experience managing complex PPP, Design-Build, Alliance, EPC, Progressive Design-Build, or integrated delivery contracts.
- Strong track record leading geographically dispersed and multidisciplinary delivery organizations.
- Industry recognition through leadership positions, thought leadership, professional associations, or major project awards.

jobs.title: Benefits Program Manager - Retirement & ESPP (Hybrid - LA or Dallas)
jobs.description:
AECOM has an opening for a Benefits Program Manager - Retirement Plans to join our Global Benefits & Well-being team in our Dallas office or a hybrid work location. The role provides professional level support to the ongoing administration of AECOM’s retirement benefits program. The qualified candidate should have diverse exposure to various forms of retirement/financial plans such as stock programs (employee stock purchase plans ESPP). defined contribution, defined benefit plans, and non-qualified deferred compensation arrangements.
This position will offer some flexibility for hybrid work schedules to include both in-office presence and telecommute/virtual work, to be based in either Dallas, TX or Los Angeles, CA.
Responsibilities include:
- Serve as the primary ESPP subject matter expert, owning plan administration, design recommendations, and participant experience.
- Oversee ESPP operations across enrollment, purchase periods, payroll deductions, refunds, qualified dispositions, and data file maintenance.
- Maintain ESPP benefits records, manage vendors and ensure accurate data exchange and reconciliations.
- Support ESPP communications, including educational materials explaining plan design and employee value.
- Ensure compliance with IRC Section 423, global tax regulations, and securities laws.
- Collaborate with Total Rewards, Compensation, and Equity teams to ensure alignment across benefit programs.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax, Payroll, and Equity Administration teams to align operations with financial reporting and payroll processes.
- Support plan governance activities, including committee meetings, fiduciary documentation, audits, and RFPs.
- Research ESPP expansion globally
- Identify opportunities, including the use of AI to improve operational efficiency, automate processes, and enhance the employee experience.
- Act as a trusted advisor to HR leadership to research, analyze and resolve issues timely.
- Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and best practices in retirement and stock programs.
- Serve as back-up for Qualified and Non-Qualified plan administration.
Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor’s Degree, in Finance, Business Administration, or related field, plus at least 6 years of relevant experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Significant hands-on ESPP experience.
- Demonstrated knowledge of Section 423 ESPP, SEC regulations, ERISA, DOL,, and IRS requirements.
- Prior experience managing global ESPP programs for publicly traded company stock programs.
- Strong project management and problem-solving skills

jobs.title: Senior Asset Management Consultant - Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
Shape the future of critical water infrastructure assets
AECOM's Asset Management team partners with some of Australia's most important infrastructure owners to improve asset performance, reliability and long-term service outcomes.
We're looking for a proven and experienced Asset Management Consultant to play a key role in strengthening and growing our Asset Management capability across New South Wales, with a particular focus on one of our most important local government partnerships.
This role offers the opportunity to become a trusted advisor in Central Coast, working closely with client stakeholders to develop practical, data-driven asset management strategies across water and sewer infrastructure.
You'll be based from either our Newcastle or Sydney offices, but you'll spend approximately three days per week embedded within the client environment (in Central Coast ). In this role you'll focus on building relationships and helping drive better asset lifecycle decisions, while also having options to attend AECOM offices (Sydney or Newcastle) flexibly, and utilising flexible working, including WFH as needed.
How you'll make a difference
- Lead the development of strategic, tactical and operational asset management solutions for critical water and sewer infrastructure.
- Transform asset condition, utilisation, defect and performance data into practical lifecycle strategies and asset management plans.
- Develop and review Asset Management Plans, Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs), lifecycle strategies, maintenance frameworks and investment plans.
- Act as a trusted advisor to key client stakeholders, providing practical recommendations that improve asset performance and service outcomes.
- Lead project delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong client satisfaction and commercial success.
- Support business development activities and help grow AECOM's Asset Management presence across NSW.
- Mentor and support junior consultants while contributing to a collaborative and high-performing team culture.
The qualities that help you thrive
The following experience is highly desired, but if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you.
Ideally, you'll bring:
- 8-15 years' experience in Asset Management, ideally within a consulting environment.
- Strong experience developing asset lifecycle, maintenance and investment strategies across infrastructure assets.
- The ability to translate strategic objectives into practical and actionable asset management plans.
- Experience working directly with clients and building trusted long-term relationships.
- A proactive, autonomous consulting style with the ability to solve problems and lead projects independently.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and commercial skills.

Bonus points for:
- Water, wastewater or utility infrastructure experience.
- Experience supporting local government, water authorities or infrastructure owners.
- Knowledge of ISO 55000 or contemporary asset management frameworks and practices.
Why you'll love working with us
- Flexible work arrangements including hybrid work, alternative start and finish times, part-time and job-sharing options.
- Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave each year.
- Volunteer leave and employee representation leave.

- Continuous learning through professional development, study assistance and global career opportunities.
- Work with industry-leading specialists across Australia and New Zealand.

AECOM is seeking an exceptional Program Management Consultant to join our Transportation team in Raleigh, North Carolina, where they will help shape, lead, and deliver transformative transportation programs that make a lasting impact on communities.
This position will primarily support transportation clients and projects across North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Alabama, and serve as a key contributor to AECOM’s strategic direction in the region. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge strategy and execution, connecting operations, program delivery, data-driven insights, and organizational performance to drive meaningful results for clients.
The successful candidate will engage with transportation agency leaders to implement complex programs, including strategy, goal setting, policy development, performance monitoring, and portfolio management. and deliver project portfolios. This role is ideal for professionals with a background in program management and a passion for helping government agencies improve performance and drive results. Candidates should be naturally curious, strong listeners, reliable task executors, analytical problem-solvers, and capable of translating broad client visions into structured programs.
Key areas of responsibility may include:
- Transportation industry advisory & strategic consulting, including topics related to funding strategy, forecasting, scenario planning, and policy development.
- Transportation program & portfolio management, including program goal setting and portfolio delivery performance monitoring.
- Data analytics and business intelligence for decision making.
- Client relationship management, primarily with state DOTs and large municipal transportation agencies.
- Business development strategic planning and facilitation.
- Collaboration & team leadership, including mentoring and developing junior staff.
- Position supports clients and projects across the region and may support select national initiatives as opportunities arise.
Minimum:
- Bachelor's degree and 6 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Experience supporting public-sector program management or organizational improvement initiatives.
- Experience managing multiple assignments and stakeholders.
- Experience working effectively with government executives, managers, and technical staff at all organizational levels.
- Demonstrated experience applying strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills to solve complex challenges and deliver successful outcomes.

Preferred:
- 10 or more years of relevant experience.
- Master’s degree in public administration, public policy, engineering, transportation planning, business administration, or related field.
- Background in transportation, public administration, and project management.
- Experience interacting directly with executive leadership and senior decision makers.
- Experience developing strategic plans, implementation plans, governance models, performance management systems, or organizational improvement initiatives.
- Familiarity with Power BI and other performance management tools.
- Experience supporting business development, client account management, proposal preparation, and capture planning at a consulting firm.
- Interest or experience in artificial intelligence, digital transformation, transportation innovation, or organizational modernization.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager – Global Project Accounting & Financial Performance is a senior leadership role with end-to-end accountability for financial performance, operational excellence, and service delivery outcomes across a large, regional Project Accounting organization.
This role owns financial KPIs, service level performance, stakeholder satisfaction, and continuous improvement outcomes, serving as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, regional finance leadership, and global delivery stakeholders. The position combines strategic leadership, governance ownership, and hands-on oversight of complex financial operations supporting high-value, multi-year infrastructure projects.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
- Act as a primary senior point of contact for executive stakeholders, including regional Finance Leads, Project Directors, Business Line Leaders, and Global Service Delivery leadership.
- Build and maintain trusted, influential relationships with senior stakeholders through proactive engagement, transparent communication, and consistent delivery against commitments.
- Lead stakeholder governance forums, performance reviews, and escalation discussions, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, and outcomes.
- Translate complex financial and operational data into clear executive-level insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making.

KPI Ownership & Performance Management
- Own and govern the full suite of financial, operational, and service delivery KPIs, ensuring alignment with global standards, SLAs, and business expectations.
- Establish performance targets, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track productivity, quality, timeliness, financial accuracy, cash flow, and margin performance.
- Drive a performance-driven culture, holding leaders and teams accountable for results and corrective actions.
- Lead root-cause analysis for KPI variances and ensure timely execution of remediation and continuous improvement plans.
- Regularly report performance outcomes, trends, and risks to senior leadership, including recommendations for strategic or operational intervention.

Financial Ownership
- Provide senior oversight of project financial execution, including revenue recognition, cost control, reserves, contingencies.
- Review and interpret complex commercial and contractual arrangements to ensure appropriate financial treatment and risk mitigation.
- Oversee analysis of WIP, unbilled costs, billings in excess of earnings, and receivables to drive improvements in cash flow, margin, and financial predictability.
- Serve as a senior escalation authority for complex accounting judgments, ensuring compliance with IFRS, U.S. GAAP, and internal control requirements.

Operational Excellence & Service Delivery
- Lead a large, geographically distributed organization of, ensuring scalable, resilient, and high-quality service delivery.
- Ensure consistent execution of global processes, standards, and controls across regions and end markets.
- Partner with GPOs, Global Service Delivery Leads, and functional leaders to drive operational stability, maturity, and standardization.
- Oversee capacity planning, workforce optimization, utilization, and skill mix to support business growth and changing demand.

Transformation & Continuous Improvement
- Own and lead finance transformation initiatives aligned with global strategy, including process standardization, automation, and digital enablement.
- Identify opportunities to enhance value-added services, shifting the function from transactional execution to strategic financial partnership.
- Drive tower alignment and harmonization of processes, controls, and reporting frameworks.
- Champion a continuous improvement mindset supported by data, benchmarks, and best-in-class practices.

Risk, Controls & Compliance
- Ensure robust governance, internal controls, and compliance with SOX, audit requirements, and internal policies.
- Lead preparation and support for internal and external audits, business risk reviews, and project health assessments.
- Own business continuity planning and execution for the function, ensuring operational resilience and risk mitigation.

Talent & Leadership Development
- Set clear leadership expectations and build a strong management layer capable of sustaining performance at scale.
- Drive talent strategy including recruitment, succession planning, retention, and leadership development.
- Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous learning aligned with AECOM values.
- Act as a role model for inclusive leadership, ethical decision-making, and professional excellence.
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

- Professional accounting qualification (CPA or equivalent) strongly preferred.

Experience
- 15+ years of progressive experience in multinational, complex organizations, with significant senior leadership responsibility.
- Proven track record in the Engineering, Design, and Construction or project-based services industry.
- Demonstrated success leading large teams within shared services or global delivery models.
- Strong experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing at executive level.

Technical Expertise
- Deep expertise in Project Accounting and financial performance management.
- Advanced knowledge of revenue recognition (IFRS 15 / IAS 11 / ASC 606), U.S. GAAP, and SOX controls.
- Strong understanding of project lifecycles, contract types, and commercial risk management.
- Experience with large ERP platforms (Oracle, SAP, Blackline, or similar).
- Advanced analytical capability and executive-level reporting skills.

Leadership Competencies
- Enterprise Leadership & Strategic Thinking
- Executive Stakeholder Influence
- KPI-Driven Performance Management
- Change Leadership & Transformation
- Operational Excellence at Scale
- Complex Problem Solving & Financial Judgment
- Results Orientation with Strong Governance Discipline

jobs.title: Regional Operations Manager - Traffic Operations Center Services
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Regional Operations Manager - Traffic Operations Center Services to oversee a staff of over 50 full-time professionals, based out of our client’s Staunton, VA facility and surrounding area facilities.  This position is responsible for overseeing client policy implementation, quality control, inter- and intra- Virginia governmental agency coordination efforts, regional contract management, and maintaining effective staffing levels.
Responsibilities:
- Acts as the primary point of contact, on-site, for the client agency
- Responsible for the organizational management and direct supervision of the Traffic Operations Center (TOC) operations staff, facilitating a cohesive and balanced operation.
- Review applicant resumes, conduct interviews, and recommend for hire/advancement.
- Administrative functions, including invoice processing, shift scheduling, liaising with AECOM corporate management, staff recruitment, training, payroll processing, personnel performance reviews, and conflict resolution.
- Develop and maintain routine personnel performance assessments.
- Maintain 24/7 awareness of the control room’s equipment status, coordinating service failures with field maintenance and information technology staff to ensure maximum system availability.
- Coordinate with client on citizen issues related to complaints, inquiries, and public information requests.
- Share (or assume) responsibilities with (for) the client for TOC public relations activities such as: TOC public outreach efforts, facility tours, presentations, and Traffic Incident Management (TIM) team meetings.
- Routinely report to client and company stakeholders on the operation’s efficiency and effectiveness in providing regional traffic management, traveler information, incident management, traffic signal operations, and active vehicle detection systems. Prepare regular reports on the performance of the system based on pre-determined measures of effectiveness.
- Assist in maintaining sound freeway operations by guiding essential control room operation decisions, developing special event response plans, participating in post-incident analysis exercises, and by ensuring that staff resources are being tasked in an impactful manner.
- Responsible for the comprehensive training and auditing of the operations staff.
- Participate in meetings, seminars, conferences, and committees as appropriate and assigned by the client.
- Write and maintain technical documents, including but not limited to: the TOC Operations, Manual/Standard Operations Procedures, training programs, and TOC website content.
- Serve, eventually, as a subject matter expert for the client and AECOM on TOC control room operations, freeway incident management, operations statistical analysis, and field maintenance practices.
Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree plus 10 years of relevant experience including 2 years of leadership or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education (Associate's degree + 12 years of experience, High School Diploma or Equivalent + 14 years of experience - including 2 years of leadership)
- Valid US Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices.  As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review
- Ability and willingness to work alternate work schedules and be on-call 24 hours/day as needed
- Condition of employment candidates must pass substance abuse test

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or related transportation field
- 10 years of relevant experience is preferred
- 5 years of experience in a supervisory role within a transportation, public safety, or commercial operations environment
- General knowledge of traffic principles and standards
- Experience with report writing, technical writing, management team presentations, spreadsheet analysis, and interoffice communication
- Experience coordinating real-time activities and initiating immediate priorities, for self and support staff
- Experience using standard software applications such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Access, Outlook)
- Demonstrated Radio and phone communications experience
- Geographic familiarity with regional arterial and interstate road network is helpful
- Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
- Relocation support is available
- Ability and willingness to work alternate work schedules and be on-call 24 hours/day as needed
- Work environment may vary indoor/outdoor
- On-site availability is required during periods of emergency operations

jobs.title: Chemical Warfare Material Program Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM has a need for a Chemical Warfare Material Manager to based anywhere in the United States.
You will work with a team of technical experts to deliver remediation services to our clients in the Federal market. In this role, you will perform a variety of functions and serve as a Deputy Program and Client Manager for the USACE Huntsville Center..  This position can be remote.

AECOM is proud to provide our employees with exciting, challenging projects and career opportunities. Imagine working on rewarding projects  and having access to exceptional training and career development opportunities. Working at AECOM means being part of a global team, working with award-winning professionals across the world.

Responsibilities will include, but may not be limited to the following:
- Manage/perform CWM removal under a FFP or CPFF contract for USACE
- Develop complex technical approaches and competitive pricing for the identification and removal of CWM and/or traditional munitions.
- Prepare CWM workplans and schedules, managed budgets and quality, and lead field teams during removal actions in the field.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENT
- BS/BA in engineering, environmental science, soil science, geology and or an earth science-related field
- 10+ years’ experience, including 2 years of leadership,  as a Project Manager of federal projects and or demonstrated equivalency of experience and /or education
- Due to the nature of the work, US citizenship is required
- Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENT
- USACE MMRP experience performing CWM remediation operations.
- Thorough knowledge of USACE EP 75-1-3 and been involved with the development and implementation of a DDESB-approved Chemical Safety Submission (CSS) to conduct CWM removal actions.
- 5+ years’ experience managing CWM task order work for USACE Huntsville Center strongly preferred
- Demonstrated ability to manage projects to scope, schedule, and budget
- Knowledge of project financial accounting, reporting, and controls
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including both oral and written
- Organizational management skills and ability to perform detail-oriented work
- Experienced on MMR programs, including CWM and advanced geophysical classification
- Experience managing CWM projects for  the USACE Huntsville Center and/or Redstone Arsenal.
- Demonstrated proposal-writing skills, Multiple Award Task Order Contract proposals
- Demonstrated ability to market and win work successfully and effectively
- Advanced knowledge of DoD and USACE MMR focusing on CWM requirements and processes
- Excellent and relevant references
- Position may require travel
- THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 26TH, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Materials and Asset Management Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Materials and Asset Management Consultant who excels at applying their theoretical skills to real world problems to create sustainable solutions. In this role, you will identify and address complex engineering challenges for clients in industries such as infrastructure, utilities, and government. You will also combine your research knowledge with prior consulting experience to deliver practical and sustainable solutions for our clients.
Key Responsibilities:
- Durability management for engineering projects – Support the development and implementation of project-specific durability strategies from concept design through to delivery.
- Technical assessment and service life modelling - Assess environmental exposures using national and international standards and identify their influence on the deterioration mechanisms common construction materials, such as concrete, masonry, steel and timber.
- Specification of construction materials and additional protective measures – Prepare technical specifications for concrete, steel, coatings and composite materials, ensuring compliance with AS, BS, EN and ACI standards.
- Condition assessment of existing structures – Plan and execute inspections of concrete, steel and composite structures, incorporating non-destructive testing, material sampling and laboratory testing.
- Design of repairs, remediation and rehabilitation to arrest deterioration – Develop repair strategies that address both symptoms and underlying causes of deterioration. Prepare design documentation for concrete repairs and crack injection, surface treatments and cathodic protection. Select solutions that balance durability, constructability, safety and whole-of-life value.
- Asset Management – Development of a range of strategic, tactical, operational documents such as Asset Maintenance Plan, Asset Lifecycle Plans, and Strategic Asset management plan (SAMP)
- Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g. Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or Materials Science)
- Prior consulting experience in Australia
- Hands-on exposure to predictive modelling of deterioration mechanisms in concrete.
- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues and propose creative solutions.
- Proficient in relevant engineering and analytical software (e.g. Excel, Autodesk, Midas, etc).
- Willingness to travel and work away from home for inspection-based work.
- Experience across major infrastructure sectors (bridges, tunnels, ports and water infrastructure).

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager - Aviation - Las Vegas
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced  Sr Program Manager  to lead major U.S. airport development and capital improvement programs. This position will be based in Las Vegas, NV. This right candidate provide strategic direction, oversight, and leadership for complex aviation initiatives, ensuring successful delivery across planning, design, and construction. The Senior Program Manager will work closely with airport authorities, multidisciplinary teams, external stakeholders, and AECOM leadership to drive program execution, mitigate risks, and maintain alignment with client objectives.
This position offers an opportunity to manage high-visibility airside and landside programs that shape long-term airport infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and support operational efficiency.
Job Responsibilities
Program Leadership & Strategy
- Oversee full program lifecycle for large, multi-year aviation development programs, including planning, design, procurement, and construction.
- Provide executive-level leadership, decision-making guidance, and strategic direction to technical teams.
- Establish program governance frameworks, reporting structures, and performance metrics.
- Drive alignment between client goals, regulatory requirements, operational constraints, and project execution plans.

Stakeholder Engagement
- Serve as the primary interface with airport authorities, senior leadership, regulatory agencies, and third-party partners.
- Facilitate program workshops, progress meetings, executive presentations, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
- Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients and key program participants.

Technical Oversight
- Review program scopes, design deliverables, technical studies, phasing concepts, cost estimates, and construction packages.
- Provide direction on airside, landside, and terminal elements including runways, taxiways, aprons, roadways, utilities, vertical facilities, and support infrastructure.
- Monitor adherence to FAA regulations, airport design standards, environmental requirements, and industry best practices.

Program Controls & Reporting
- Manage program budgets, schedules, risk registers, change control, and cost forecasts.
- Oversee program reporting, dashboard development, and executive summaries.
- Ensure prompt resolution of issues affecting cost, schedule, quality, safety, and operational continuity.

Team Leadership
- Lead, mentor, and support multidisciplinary teams of project managers, engineers, construction managers, and controls specialists.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Support staff development, recruitment, performance reviews, and succession planning.
Minimum Requirements
- BA/BS and 12+ years of related experience in program or project management for aviation infrastructure projects or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership.
- This position requires passing airport-specific background checks and obtaining badges or clearances.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Planning, Business Administration, or related discipline.
- PMP certification or equivalent.
- Proven experience delivering major airport development programs (airside, landside, or terminal).
- Strong understanding of FAA standards, airport planning principles, environmental processes, and construction phasing.
- Demonstrated ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and manage client relationships at the executive level.
- Experience with program controls systems and reporting platforms.
- Experience with major hub airports and multi-billion-dollar capital programs.
- Familiarity with AECOM processes, tools, and integrated delivery models.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
- Sponsorship is not offered for this position.
- Relocation support may be available for qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Program Manager Facility Design, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
AECOM  is seeking an Program Manager  specializing in  Hyper-scale Data Centers. This position is a remote opportunity and can be based out of any of AECOM's U.S. offices.
This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US were AECOM has an office.
Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.
AECOM  is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.
About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to play a critical leadership role within the AECOM US Data Center Practice. Candidate will be responsible for driving business performance, leading major proposal efforts, managing strategic client programs, and ensuring successful execution of high-value design projects.
This role operates at the intersection of business development, client management, and project delivery, ensuring that client pursuits are competitive, programs are executed efficiently, and financial and operational objectives are achieved.
The Program Manager will partner closely with executive leadership, design directors, client account managers, and discipline leaders to support revenue growth, client satisfaction, and operational excellence across hyperscale and colocation data center programs.
This position is ideal for a highly organized, business-minded leader with deep experience in managing complex A/E/C programs and supporting major proposal pursuits.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide program-level leadership across multiple concurrent data center design projects
- Monitor program performance including schedule, budget, staffing, and risk
- Identify and resolve program-level constraints impacting delivery
- Ensure consistency of execution across multiple projects and clients
- Support Design Managers and Project Managers in maintaining successful delivery
- Support business development and proposal writing for new pursuits.
- Lead preparation of major technical and commercial proposals, including: - Go / No-Go coordination
- Proposal schedules and deliverable management
- Fee strategy coordination
- Staffing plans and resource alignment
- Executive review coordination
- Interview preparation and coaching
- Coordinate closely with Client Account Managers, and Technical Leaders
- Improve proposal processes, templates, and win strategies
- Support capture planning for strategic pursuits
- Serve as a key point of contact for strategic clients

- Participate in client meetings, presentations, and program reviews
- Support Client Account Managers in maintaining strong client relationships
- Help identify new opportunities within existing client programs
- Assist in managing client expectations and overall client experience
- ·Travel as needed for project-related activities such as client meetings and site visits.
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field plus eight (8) years of relevant experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Minimum 5+ years managing complex programs or major projects
- Experience supporting or leading proposal efforts
- Strong understanding of A/E/C project delivery process
- Excellent communication and leadership skills
- Strong business and financial acumen
- Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities

Preferred Qualifications:
- 10 plus years of relevant experience.
- Direct experience supporting data center projects
- Experience working with hyperscale or colocation clients
- Experience managing large multi-disciplinary design teams
- Experience with Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build delivery models
- PMP certification preferred
- Professional licensure (Architect, Engineer) is a plus but not required
- US Citizenship
- Relocation is not available for this role.
- Sponsorship is not available for this role.
- THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 9, 2026.

jobs.title: Join Our Growing Project & Programme Management Team at AECOM Ireland
jobs.description:
Start here. Grow here.
Join Our Growing Project & Programme Management Team at AECOM Ireland
At AECOM, we're proud of our growing Project & Programme Management team, delivering complex and high-profile projects across Ireland. As our portfolio continues to expand, we're looking for talented, collaborative and passionate professionals to help shape the future of our communities and infrastructure.
If you have experience in project or programme management and are looking to work on impactful, multidisciplinary projects within a dynamic and supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you.
Ready to take the next step in your career?
Submit your CV today and become part of a global consultancy that values innovation, collaboration, technical excellence and professional growth.
Why Join AECOM?
Deliver Meaningful Projects
Our Project & Programme Management team delivers some of Ireland's most significant projects across commercial, healthcare, education, data centres, rail, civil infrastructure, transport, utilities and major public sector programmes. You'll help clients successfully deliver projects that create lasting value, while working with multidisciplinary teams and leveraging industry-leading digital tools and innovative delivery approaches.
Professional Growth
At AECOM, your development starts from day one. We invest in our people through structured career progression, mentoring, technical excellence programmes and leadership opportunities, enabling you to grow within a diverse, dynamic and expanding team.
Flexibility
Our diverse project portfolio means we're always looking for different skills, backgrounds and levels of experience. We take a flexible approach to recruitment and often create opportunities around exceptional talent to ensure the right fit for both our people and our projects.
Sectors We Support
Our workload spans a wide range of sectors, including:
- Commercial
- Healthcare
- Education
- Data Centres
- Rail
- Civil Infrastructure
- Transport
- Utilities
- Residential
- Public Sector Programmes

Locations
Dublin | Cork | Galway | Belfast
If you have a background in project or programme management, we'd encourage you to submit your CV. We'll consider your application against both current vacancies and upcoming opportunities across our growing business.
Who We're Looking For
We're seeking experienced professionals across a range of roles, from Project Manager and Senior Project Manager through to Associate Director and Programme Manager.
You'll bring experience in leading projects and programmes from inception through delivery, successfully managing scope, schedule, cost, risk and stakeholder relationships while delivering high-quality outcomes for clients.
We're particularly interested in professionals with experience across one or more of the following sectors:
- Rail
- Civil Infrastructure
- Transport
- Healthcare
- Education
- Commercial
- Data Centres
- Utilities
- Residential
- Major Capital Programmes

Come Grow with Us.
At AECOM, you'll thrive in an inclusive, forward-thinking environment where your ideas and contributions are valued. Alongside exciting career opportunities, you'll benefit from a comprehensive package designed to support your professional development and personal wellbeing.
From technical practice networks, mentoring and AECOM University, to volunteering opportunities and our flexible hybrid working model, you'll have the tools, support and flexibility to build a rewarding career while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s What We’re Looking For
As a successful candidate, you will have experience working within our key markets — including commercial , public sector , and infrastructure projects. We are looking for individuals who combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Qualifications & Experience:
- A postgraduate qualification in Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related field

- Actively pursuing Chartered Status with one of the following professional institutions:
- SCSI / RICS

- CIOB

- RIBA

- Engineers Ireland (EI)

- APM affiliation is considered an advantage

You will thrive in a collaborative environment and be passionate about delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions across complex and high-profile projects.
We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at  ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com . At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.
