jobs.title: Program Management Director
jobs.description:
AECOM is currently looking for an experienced Program Management Director to join our team, leading on a complex program in Panama.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Lead and manage rail infrastructure program that is mega in size (multi-billion dollar), have high risk reward, are of high strategic value and/or have the highest level of execution complexity.
- Provides the organization with technical leadership and strategic direction for program delivery globally.
- Champion to oversee and provide assurance for ethical and safe working practices.
- Drives innovation in program management approaches and methodology to achieve marketplace differentiation.
- Works with Global Business Lines, Regional leadership and Market Sector Leaders to identify new business opportunities and develop solutions to address them.
- Identifies areas of high risk and pro-actively takes actions to positively impact program outcomes.
- Contributes to the global learning and people development strategy for program management, including identification of talent gaps and resourcing plans.
- Assess long-term and disruptive trends in their area of expertise. Proposes skill development approaches and workforce planning to deliver capabilities for the future.
- Actively supports the attraction and retention of talent across area of expertise.
- Accountable for overall financial success and delivery of AECOM Program Management agreement
- Advise AECOM clients on the benefits and drawbacks of potential delivery models for the projects within the program, including PPP, D/BB, DB, DBFOM and variants, Progressive DB, Alliance and variants
- Mobilize and manage resources required to support all phases of a program
- Lead and manage the client’s role in P3 and Progressive Design Build contracts to fulfill client expectations
- Support market engagements and market sounding activities
- Manage scope, budget and schedule, including contract administration, claims and quality compliance
- Ensure that appropriate risk management analysis, status reporting and issues management processes are in place

This vacancy aims to strengthen our talent pool for future opportunities.
Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline.
- 15+ years of experience in program management inclusive of at least 6 (six) years of recent experience in a Senior Leadership position ideally leading large passenger Rail Infrastructure projects or programs of $500Million+.

Preferred Qualifications
- Ideally 20+ years of relevant experience
- PMI-PgMP, APM-RPP or CMAA-CCM Certification (or equivalent) preferred but not essential
- Strong technical capability including all project phases from design, planning, construction, operations and maintenance preferably large program/projects
- Considerable experience of delivering in collaborative working arrangements
- Demonstrable experience of delivering targeted Project benefits
- Demonstrated experience in extensive public outreach, agency coordination, third party stakeholder management and program management
- Strong knowledge of relevant rail standards applicable in industry guidelines and current transit- oriented practices
- Expertise in managing and coordinating interfaces all disciplines (e.g., environmental, mechanical, civil, structural)
- Experienced in developing and mobilizing project delivery systems and optimizing processes and procedures
- Demonstrated experience of successfully integrating complex programs and managing/coordinating interfaces across all disciplines (e.g., program/project controls, environmental, H&S, design, construction)
- Recognized globally as a leader in program management within the industry
- Able to demonstrate an extensive industry-wide network and is well known for having successfully shaped, led or transformed multiple large or very large programs.
- Has a deep knowledge and application of all aspects of the program management competencies needed for success on very complex programs, educates and mentors others and has guided and facilitated others in all aspects of the identified program competencies in very complex programs.
- Demonstrates exemplary leadership attributes that provide role modelling for others.
- Able to build consensus to change program strategy in challenging situations.
- Demonstrated ability to set long term goals and strategies and establish effective management of internal and external interfaces and inter-dependencies across the program.
- Has built diverse and inclusive teams to enable collective success through trust, psychological safety, autonomy, accountability and alignment.

jobs.title: Senior Civil Design and Program Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM’s Water Business Line is seeking a talented and experienced  Senior Civil Design and Program Manager  to lead our growing Civil Design Practice, with a home base in Buffalo, NY, Rochester, NY or Syracuse, NY. It is expected that this role will provide support to projects throughout the Northeast US. This is a hybrid position.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in municipal water, wastewater, and/or stormwater design, analysis, inspection and management in dense urban settings. The preferred candidate will have a proven ability to lead a team of engineers and designers to deliver successful projects. General technical background in condition assessment and implementing management solutions for pressurized water systems is also desired.
This position offers a unique opportunity to work within an established and successful local and national group that offers a diverse range of technical challenges and career development opportunities. In this role, you will also have an opportunity to mentor junior staff and interact with key clients. Join our growing civil design practice and help us continue to deliver innovative and successful projects.
The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:
- Lead complex design projects from the planning through permitting and construction phases, including alternative delivery projects.
- Experience working with mid-level staff and leading multi-discipline project design teams locally and remotely.
- Interface with client and regulatory agencies and play a major role on presentations to existing or potential clients.
- Experience in civil and stormwater design.
- Design of pipe conveyance and coordination/understanding of modeling of collection systems.
- Develop and review design and construction plans, specifications, and cost estimates.
- Oversee and prepare engineering reports and documentations.
- Prepare engineering services proposals, fee estimates, and schedules.
- Conduct field inspections and assessments to ensure compliance with design standards and regulations.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and design staff.
- Stay current on industry trends and advancements in design and engineering.
- Assess trends in the marketplace and lead strategy and assist with proposal development with support from local and national staff to capture expanded suite of services AECOM can offer clients.
- Provide construction administration support.
Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Civil or Environmental engineering, or other related field required, and 10 years of relevant experience.
- Professional Engineer in the state of NY, or ability to obtain PE licensure within 1 year of employment.
- Demonstrated experience developing engineering deliverables such as engineering reports, design drawings, technical specifications, and other detailed engineering deliverables.
- Proven and demonstrated experience working on stormwater, water, wastewater, or flood protection/resilience projects.
- Valid U.S. Driver’s License and as a condition of employment, must pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records Review.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 15 years of extensive project experience in municipal water, wastewater and/or stormwater design, analysis, installation, inspection, and management in design within dense urban settings
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to be client-facing.
- Strong knowledge of water/wastewater/stormwater design codes, standards, and regulations
- Pipeline condition assessment and rehabilitation experience
- Experience with combined sewer overflow communities with planning, design and construction of combined sewer overflow infrastructure (Storage tanks/tunnels/sewer separation)
- Coordination of projects with civil design and modeling teams
- Strong communication skills in coordinating with clients, sub-consultants, regulatory agencies, and members of the public to accomplish assigned objectives.
- Strong commitment to ensuring safe project execution.
- Must have excellent organizational skills and be able to work well in a team environment.
- Makes decisions independently on engineering problems and methods.

jobs.title: Aviation Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Aviation Senior Program Manager  to lead major Texas airport development and capital improvement programs. This position will be based in San Antonio, TX. This right candidate provide strategic direction, oversight, and leadership for complex aviation initiatives, ensuring successful delivery across planning, design, and construction. The Senior Program Manager will work closely with airport authorities, multidisciplinary teams, external stakeholders, and AECOM leadership to drive program execution, mitigate risks, and maintain alignment with client objectives.
This position offers an opportunity to manage high-visibility airside and landside programs that shape long-term airport infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and support operational efficiency.
Job Responsibilities
Program Leadership & Strategy
- Oversee full program lifecycle for large, multi-year aviation development programs, including planning, design, procurement, and construction.
- Provide executive-level leadership, decision-making guidance, and strategic direction to technical teams.
- Establish program governance frameworks, reporting structures, and performance metrics.
- Drive alignment between client goals, regulatory requirements, operational constraints, and project execution plans.

Stakeholder Engagement
- Serve as the primary interface with airport authorities, senior leadership, regulatory agencies, and third-party partners.
- Facilitate program workshops, progress meetings, executive presentations, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
- Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients and key program participants.

Technical Oversight
- Review program scopes, design deliverables, technical studies, phasing concepts, cost estimates, and construction packages.
- Provide direction on airside, landside, and terminal elements including runways, taxiways, aprons, roadways, utilities, vertical facilities, and support infrastructure.
- Monitor adherence to FAA regulations, airport design standards, environmental requirements, and industry best practices.

Program Controls & Reporting
- Manage program budgets, schedules, risk registers, change control, and cost forecasts.
- Oversee program reporting, dashboard development, and executive summaries.
- Ensure prompt resolution of issues affecting cost, schedule, quality, safety, and operational continuity.

Team Leadership
- Lead, mentor, and support multidisciplinary teams of project managers, engineers, construction managers, and controls specialists.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Support staff development, recruitment, performance reviews, and succession planning.
Minimum Requirements
- BA/BS and 12+ years of related experience in program or project management for aviation infrastructure projects or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership.
- This position requires passing airport-specific background checks and obtaining badges or clearances.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Planning, Business Administration, or related discipline.
- PMP certification or equivalent.
- Proven experience delivering major airport development programs (airside, landside, or terminal).
- Strong understanding of FAA standards, airport planning principles, environmental processes, and construction phasing.
- Demonstrated ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and manage client relationships at the executive level.
- Experience with program controls systems and reporting platforms.
- Experience with major hub airports and multi-billion-dollar capital programs.
- Familiarity with AECOM processes, tools, and integrated delivery models.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
- Sponsorship is not offered for this position.
- Relocation support may be available for qualified candidates.

jobs.description:

Are you a market-savvy growth leader with a passion for building client relationships and winning complex, high-value work? AECOM is looking for a Business Line Growth Director to lead client engagement, pursuit excellence, and market positioning for our Program Management business line across ANZ.
This is a senior, externally facing role where you will champion strategic pursuits, shape client account strategies, and position AECOM as the partner of choice in priority markets. You'll work alongside the Sector Directors, Sector Managers and ANZ Growth Leads to drive bookings growth and elevate our presence across the region.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead and deepen client engagement with key decision-makers, influencers, and partners across priority markets.
- Own the business line's external market positioning — tracking trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities to sharpen pursuit strategies.
- Partner with the Sector Directors, Growth Leads, and Client Account Managers to identify and win Enterprise Critical Pursuits (ECPs) and Tier 2 pursuits.
- Support and hold accountable Client Account Managers on client account plan delivery, growth targets, and relationship objectives.
- Represent AECOM in professional associations, industry forums, and sector events to build brand and create market opportunities.
- Drive thought leadership at key conferences and sector events.
- Apply best-practice capture processes — go/no-go decisions, pre-positioning, capture planning, proposal development, risk management, and governance.
- Embed enterprise capabilities, digital solutions, and workshare opportunities into key pursuits.
- Contribute targeted market intelligence to the BL strategic plan and track progress against forecasts and bookings.

Education :
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.

Certifications :
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification.
- Additional certifications in program management or business development are advantageous.

Relevant Experience
Work Experience :
- - Minimum of 10 years of experience in program management, project management, or business development roles, ideally within the construction, engineering, or consulting sectors.
- Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale projects and programs.
- Experience in leading teams and managing cross-functional collaborations.

Business Development :
- - Demonstrated experience in identifying and securing new business opportunities.
- Strong network within the ANZ market, particularly in relevant industries.

Influence & Relationships
- Builds trust and credibility with senior leaders, clients, and partners. Develops alignment and drives action across diverse teams and stakeholders.

- - Deep understanding of market dynamics, business strategy, and competitive positioning across Program Management in Australia. Supports data-informed decisions that balance growth with operational discipline.

Strategy & Market

- Strategic Thinking, ability to develop and implement effective growth strategies that align with corporate goals.

Personal Attributes
- Results-oriented with a proactive approach to challenges.
- Adaptability to changing market conditions and client needs.
- High level of integrity and professionalism.

Your initial program will involve working on an exciting, deadline-driven key strategic water program based in the Greater Baltimore, MD and/or Washington, DC area.
At AECOM, we’re united by a common purpose of delivering a better world.
Our Global Program Management business provides the structure, tools, techniques and process to deliver on this vision.
By connecting our expertise across services, markets, and geographies, we manage outcome-driven projects that deliver social, economic and environmental value. These include programs of critical national importance in defense, transport, water, clean energy, environmental clean-up, international development and disaster recovery, as well as the shaping of many of the world’s major cities.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Lead and manage programs that are medium to large in size and complexity.
- Provides the organization with technical leadership and strategic direction for program delivery globally.
- Champion for ethical and safe working practices.
- Drives innovation in program management approaches and methodology to achieve marketplace differentiation.
- Works with Global Business Lines, Regional leadership and Market Sector Leaders to identify new business opportunities and develop solutions to address them.
- Identifies areas of high risk and pro-actively takes actions to positively impact program outcomes.
- Contributes to the global learning and people development strategy for program management, including identification of talent gaps and resourcing plans.
- Assess long-term and disruptive trends in their area of expertise. Proposes skill development approaches and workforce planning to deliver capabilities for the future.
- Actively supports the attraction and retention of talent across area of expertise.
- Accountable for overall financial success and delivery of AECOM Program Management agreement.
- Required to work at Client's office.
Minimum Qualifications:
- BA/BS in civil, environmental engineering or related degree, plus10 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Minimum of 10 years experience in water/wastewater industry, with at least 3 years leading projects/programs.
- Demonstrated water/wastewater expertise with an aspect of program management valued by clients and peers to position and/or deliver programs.
- Professional Engineer's License or ability to obtain within 1 year.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Typically, a minimum of 12 years professional experience with a least 7 years in a senior role within program management.
- Developing external network of industry contacts and peers.  Is known among clients for successfully leading medium to large size programs.
- Has familiarity with the program management competencies within programs and applies these to be successful.  Has developing experience managing others practicing the program competencies on a program.
- Ability to mentor others in developing program competencies and personally growing through mentorship of others.
- Able to develop strong relationships and manage all client stakeholders (internal and external).
- Demonstrates exemplary leadership attributes that provide role modelling for others.
- Able to build consensus to change program strategy in challenging situations.
- Demonstrated ability to set long term goals and strategies and establish effective management of internal and external interfaces and interdependencies across the program.
- Has built teams to enable collective success through trust, psychological safety, autonomy, accountability and alignment.

jobs.title: Business Development Director - Thermal Generation
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping the future of energy solutions?
AECOM is seeking a visionary and dynamic  Business Development Director - Thermal Generation  to join our team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to work across AECOM’s expansive energy practice, building capabilities, driving growth, and delivering innovative solutions to some of the world’s most forward-thinking developers, utilities and high-tech clients.
This position is a  REMOTE  role based in the United States. .
You will play a pivotal role in delivering complex, fast-paced substation, Natural Gas Power Plant, and BESS projects that meet the critical energy needs of both grid capacity enhancement for utilities, and behind the meter solutions for data center developers, with a heavy focus on natural gas generation solutions. This is your chance to make a lasting impact in a rapidly growing sector while collaborating with industry-leading experts and leveraging AECOM’s global resources.
Roles and Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:
Lead and Inspire:
- Collaborate across AECOM’s energy practice and other business lines to deliver integrated, cutting-edge solutions for thermal generation energy projects.
- Inspire and monitor multidisciplinary teams to achieve excellence in project delivery and client satisfaction.
- Serve as a thought leader in the energy sector, representing AECOM in industry forums and shaping the future of power delivery and generation for both utilities and data centers.

Drive Growth and Innovation:
- Spearhead business development efforts by identifying opportunities, leading pursuits, and crafting winning proposals.
- Build and nurture strong relationships with utilities, data center developers, high-tech clients, and other key stakeholders.
- Develop and execute strategies to expand AECOM’s presence in the thermal power generation market, positioning us as the go-to partner for power needs.

Deliver Complex Projects:
- Provide subject matter expertise for a project portfolio of design, development, and implementation of natural gas power plants and substations that meet the unique demands of a range of clientele, including utilities and data center developers.
- Assist project teams when necessary in the delivery of fast-paced, high-stakes projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
- Assist project teams when necessary in addressing technical challenges with creativity and agility, leveraging AECOM’s global expertise to deliver exceptional results.

Collaborate and Build Capabilities:
- Work across AECOM’s energy practice to strengthen our technical capabilities and drive continuous improvement.
- Partner with other business lines, including Buildings + Places and Environment, to deliver holistic solutions that address the full spectrum of client needs.
- Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring AECOM remains at the forefront of innovation in energy solutions.

Leadership and Collaboration:
- Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a talent for building relationships across stakeholders.
- Strategic thinker with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
- Manage a team of sales professionals, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations

Business Acumen:
- Experience in business development, including leading pursuits and proposals.
- Ability to identify market opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.
- Strong understanding of financial metrics and project economics.
- Develop and manage sales budgets, forecasts, and reports to track performance and identify areas for improvement

Why Join AECOM?
At AECOM, we’re not just delivering power—we’re shaping the future of how the world powers its most critical infrastructure. As the Power and Generation Project Development  Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Work with some of the most innovative data center developers and high-tech clients in the world.
- Lead fast-paced, complex projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible.
- Collaborate across AECOM’s global energy practice to build capabilities, drive growth, and deliver transformative solutions.
- Be part of a team that values creativity, innovation, and making a real impact.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and make a difference in a rapidly evolving industry, we want to hear from you!
Minimum Requirements:
- BA/BA and 10 years of relevant experience with focus on natural gas power plants or demonstrated equivalency of experience and /or education, including 2 years of leadership.
- 10 years of experience and success in leading pursuits, managing client relationships, contract negotiations and driving business growth.
- Demonstrated knowledge of the unique energy requirements for data centers, including reliability, scalability, and sustainability.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations.

- Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position

jobs.title: Data Analytics Director
jobs.description:
The Data Analytics Director provides strategic and technical leadership for enterprise reporting, business intelligence, analytics modernization, and performance management initiatives. This role transforms operational and financial data into actionable insights that support executive decision making and mission execution.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead enterprise analytics and business intelligence initiatives.
- Develop data strategies, governance frameworks, and performance measurement methodologies.
- Consolidate data from systems including SharePoint, SAM, FSMS, and other enterprise platforms.
- Design and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting solutions.
- Perform advanced analytics, forecasting, trend analysis, and data quality assessments.
- Provide insights supporting project prioritization and leadership decisions.
- Identify opportunities for automation, AI enablement, and process improvement.
- Lead data management and reporting teams.
Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor's Degree in Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field and 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
- Minimum 8 years supporting DHS or DoD environments.
- Minimum 8 years of data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance management experience.
- Experience developing dashboards and data visualization solutions using tools such as Power BI and Power Platform.
- Experience integrating and analyzing data across multiple enterprise systems.
- Due to the nature of the work U.S. Citizenship required.
- Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC).

- PMP Certification preferred.

jobs.title: Strategic Marketing Manager - Major Pursuits
jobs.description:
This is a high impact role for a strategic marketer with a proven ability to translate insight into compelling positioning that drives pursuit success. Reporting to the Head of Pursuit Marketing, Europe and India , the role will lead positioning campaigns for our most critical pursuits, working closely with capture, pursuit and marketing and communications communities to win what matters. This exciting, new role is designed for marketers that thrive in fast-paced environments – it will be key for the individual to be a self-starter and have experience in both pursuit and marketing environments.
Key Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with the Head of Pursuit Marketing and Capture Managers to design, plan and deliver pursuit marketing workshops, aligning stakeholders around client insight, value proposition, differentiation and pursuit strategy, and ensuring outputs translate into clear, actionable pursuit marketing strategy.
- Develop and deliver marketing campaigns (utilising SOSTAC) for pursuit positioning aligned to the overall win strategy.
- Lead the activation of integrated marketing tactics, working with the Marketing & Communications teams across brand, content, thought leadership, digital, social, creative, government relations and external communications.
- Identify and conduct market research on trends and competitors to inform both AECOM’s value proposition, narrative and evidence
- Make informed tactical decisions and prioritise marketing activity under pressure.
- Orchestrate complex stakeholder collaboration across pursuit teams, regions and functions.
- Define campaign KPIs, track performance and generate insight led recommendations to optimise impact and return on investment.
- Contribute to monthly and quarterly board level reporting on pursuit marketing performance.
- Use embedded AI tools and data driven approaches to improve efficiency, insight and campaign effectiveness.
- Manage allocated pursuit or campaign budgets and report performance to internal stakeholders.
- Proactively manage workload and communicate priorities, progress and risks to stakeholders.
- Degree level education in Marketing, Business Studies or a related discipline.
- Accredited at the Chartered Institute of Marketing or equivalent (preferred not essential).

Experience
- Proven marketing communications experience, ideally within a large professional services organisation.
- Marketing management experience in a professional services environment.
- Experience managing bids and marketing campaigns, ideally within pursuit or capture environments.
- Proven ability to develop positioning, value propositions and campaigns aligned to win strategies.
- Strong strategic thinker, able to articulate strategy clearly and compellingly.
- Demonstrable experience of working in a complex cross-matrixed organisation.
- Experience in developing and delivering integrated multi-channel tactics including conferences, client events, awards, social media, thought leadership and editorial activities.
- Demonstrated experience optimising marketing investment and evidencing return on investment.
- Confidence working with senior business leaders, with the ability to challenge constructively.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, bringing teams together around a common goal.
- Collaborative, energetic and client centric, with strong alignment to brand and values.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong digital capability, including multichannel content delivery and familiarity with AI enabled marketing tools.
- Working knowledge of CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), digital marketing platforms and analytics.
- Sound understanding of GDPR, pursuit procurement and compliance requirements.
- Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation and Delivery Lead - Environmental Remediation Sector
jobs.description:
AECOM   is seeking a qualified candidate to, lead the digital delivery for the remediation business in US West, from setting the direction through to getting it done. It looks across the business to find where maturing how we use digital technology will make a real difference, whether that means new systems, getting more out of what we already have, or improving the way we work. It defines what needs to happen, what it will take, when, and the benefit it will deliver, and then leads delivery.
This is a do-and-lead role. The successful candidate performs hands-on solution work where needed and leads delivery through others where capability exists, scaling their own involvement to where the gaps are. They coordinate resources from across the business to support initiatives, in the manner of a delivery lead, without line-management authority. Delivery comes first; strategy and transformation set its direction.
The role works within corporate technology direction and standards, while making the case for new technology, including emerging capabilities like AI, where there is a strong reason to. It covers the full lifecycle, improving long-running programs as well as standing up new work. While it sits within the environment business, day-to-day direction comes from the regional Digital Director of Operations, who provides functional guidance and sets digital strategy and operational direction across all business lines.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Strategy and Opportunity
- Look across the remediation business to identify where maturing the use of digital technology will create value, through new systems, enhancement of existing ones, or improved business process.
- Define what needs to be done, the resources required, the timing, and the expected benefit, and present clear recommendations to leadership for decision.
- Set and evolve the digital roadmap, prioritizing initiatives by value, urgency, complexity, and available capacity.
- Align with corporate technology direction and standards, making the case for new technology, including AI, where there is a strong business reason to adopt it.
- Maintain a working view of market trends and digital practice to inform priorities for the remediation sector.

Delivery Leadership and Execution
- Lead delivery of digital initiatives across both new and existing engagements, optimizing long running programs as well as standing up new work.
- Perform hands-on solution work directly where needed, including configuration and build on Smartsheet and the Microsoft platform.
- Oversee delivery to ensure initiatives meet scope, timing, quality, and the expected benefit, within corporate technology standards.
- Lead the selection of the right technology for each need, matching tools and platforms to the job within corporate standards and the agreed direction.

Resourcing and Coordination
- Assess where the business has capability to take on delivery work and where the gaps are, and recommend how to resource each initiative, whether in-house, from across the matrix, or through external support.
- Coordinate and provide delivery direction to resources drawn from across the business to support initiatives.

Solution Quality and Translation
- Act as the translation layer between the business and technical resources, converting business needs into clear technical direction and explaining technical constraints and options back to the business in plain terms.
- Where work is handed off, interpret requirements and provide oversight so the delivered solution meets the business need.
- Implement and oversee QA/QC processes, and review solution designs for scalability, usability, and alignment with the agreed direction.
- Develop and deploy SOPs, templates, and playbooks, in line with regional standards, for repeatable delivery.

Value, Alignment, and Reporting
- Articulate the value proposition for digital initiatives, then track and demonstrate the outcomes and benefits realized over time, showing how the business is maturing.
- Work in close partnership with the regional Digital Director of Operations, taking day-to-day direction while bringing remediation's digital priorities and progress forward.
- Build and maintain stakeholder alignment across leadership, project teams, technical resources, and end users, influencing without direct authority.
- Own leadership reporting and decision-making escalation, communicating progress, risks, and value delivered.
Minimum Requirements
- BA/BS and 8 years of experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and education, in digital delivery, digital transformation, or a related field.
- Successful candidate will undergo a background check

Preferred Qualifications
- 10+ years of experience spanning digital strategy or transformation and hands-on digital delivery.
- Demonstrated ability to both perform solution work directly and lead delivery through others, scaling involvement to where the need is.
- Hands-on experience configuring and administering Smartsheet, including Advanced Work Management (AWM).
- Experience configuring solutions across the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform ecosystem, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint.
- Familiarity with the core platforms used in the environment business, including EQuIS, alongside Smartsheet and the Microsoft suite.
- Proven ability to set a digital roadmap and prioritize initiatives by value, urgency, complexity, and capacity.
- Experience building business cases and tracking realized benefits and value over time.
- Strong ability to operate with ambiguity, turning loosely defined needs into clear direction and delivered solutions.
- Proven ability to coordinate and direct matrixed resources in a delivery-lead capacity, and to bridge business and technical teams.
- Awareness of emerging capabilities such as AI and a practical view of where they create value in a regulated environment.
- Experience in environmental remediation activities, consulting, or management.
- Preferred time zones we would like candidates to live in would be Central or Mountain.

jobs.title: Risk Management Analyst
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Risk Management Analyst to support project and program risk management activities across major infrastructure and capital projects.

The successful candidate will work with project teams and stakeholders to identify, assess, monitor, and communicate project risks and opportunities. The role requires strong analytical skills, sound professional judgement, and the ability to work independently with general direction. This is a replacement role.
Key Responsibilities
- Support the development and maintenance of project risk registers and risk management processes.
- Facilitate or support risk identification, assessment, review, and mitigation workshops.
- Work with project managers, technical leads, schedulers, cost specialists, and other stakeholders.
- Perform qualitative risk assessments and support quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis, as required.
- Track risk responses, actions, ownership, and changes in risk exposure.
- Prepare risk reports, dashboards, presentations, and other project deliverables.
- Review risk information for completeness, consistency, and quality.
- Support continuous improvement of risk management tools, procedures, and processes.
- Provide guidance and knowledge-sharing support to junior team members.
- Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Minimum Requirements
- Degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, project management, business, or a related discipline + 4 (four) years of relevant experience.
- Relevant experience in project controls, project management, risk management, or a related field.
- Experience with risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working on large infrastructure, transportation, buildings, water, or other major capital projects.
- Experience with project risk registers and risk management tools.
- Familiarity with quantitative risk analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, cost risk analysis, and/or schedule risk analysis.
- Experience with tools such as Safran Risk, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Power BI, ARM/Riskonnect, @RISK, or similar platforms .
- Understanding of recognized project risk management principles and practices.
- Professional certification in project or risk management , such as PMP, PMI-RMP, AACE PRMP/DRMP, or equivalent , would be considered an asset.
- Professional engineering licensure such as P.Eng. , or eligibility for registration, would be considered an asset.
- Professional architectural licensure such as OAA , or an equivalent architectural designation, would be considered an asset.
Key Competencies
- Technical and functional expertise
- Independent judgement and problem-solving
- Stakeholder communication and collaboration
- Quality and attention to detail
- Continuous improvement
- Adaptability
- Teamwork and knowledge sharing

jobs.title: Environmental Transportation Growth Lead - Southern California
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Environmental Transportation Growth Lead to join our dynamic team in Southern California, based in either Los Angeles or Orange, CA.
This is an exciting opportunity for a growth-oriented senior leader to spearhead the expansion of our portfolio in the Southern California region. In this role, you will have the chance to collaborate across multiple offices, drive strategic growth initiatives, and leverage AECOM’s global expertise to deliver innovative solutions for our transporation clients.
In this position you will:
- Catalyze growth of current key clients and seek opportunities to bring new clients to our EPP practice.
- Improve synergies with our local teams in the Transportation Business Line to deliver more fully integrated programs and projects with environmental services in parallel to engineering, design, or planning.
- Build out our next generation of senior practitioners in the transportation markets including transit, highways, rail, aviation, roadway, and active transportation to support projects across California.

Responsibilities of this position include:
Grow the Environmental Transportation Planning Business in Southern California:
- In collaboration with the California Environmental Transportation Planning Manager and Regional Growth Lead, develop a strategic plan for the growth of environmental planning work in the LA/Orange region that identifies greatest opportunities in the market (e.g., funding streams, key clients, market trends, etc.), leverages AECOM’s position and team, and articulates a disciplined approach to maximize growth
- Collaborate with senior staff in Southern California to understand current clients, contract vehicles, and create an engagement plan and growth strategy for those clients
- Network with existing clients to increase the volume and value of opportunities in the AECOM pipeline, focusing on maximizing existing MSAs/on-call contracts
- Partner with EPP Regional BD Leads to strategically seek out new clients to expand market presence and services
- Serve Environmental Business Line Client Lead for key LA/Orange clients
- Serve as capture manager on key opportunities including pre-positioning, win strategy, solution development, competitor analysis, and identifying resources to fully respond to the bid requirements
- Collaborate with other Southern California capture managers, client account managers, and project managers with developing Salesforce pipeline, tracking opportunities, support GNG decisions, support proposal strategy, and identify staffing needs

Cross-business line Environmental Planning liaison for LA/Orange Region
- Meet regularly with Transportation Business Line leadership to identify opportunities for EPP staff to support current projects and position for upcoming opportunities
- Identify Transportation Business Line clients/contracts to mine for environmental planning services
- Lead strategic cross-business line pursuits in partnership with other Business Lines
- Facilitate coordination of cross practice/business line collaboration to ensure winning team and technical approach during proposal development and project execution
- Serve as a key representative of the EPP practice in AECOM’s LA Metro+ organization and AECOM’s LA Initiative.

Regional Transportation Market Leadership
- Provide contract management-level oversight and execution of transportation-focused environmental planning programs and projects throughout Southern California and broader West Region
- Integrate into statewide Caltrans Client Account program and pursue Caltrans Environmental On-Call opportunities
- Advance consistent tools and technical approaches for delivering high-quality, profitable work in AECOM’s transportation sector
- Mentor mid-level environmental planning staff in the execution of transportation projects

People Leadership
- Support the growth of the team, through internal and/or external recruitment, of environmental professionals focused on supporting transportation and transit projects
- Support the development and implementation of a recruitment plan to support growth of identified key clients

About AECOM’s Environment Business Line

jobs.title: Vice President, Transportation Business Development Lead
jobs.description:
AECOM  is seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President, Business Development Lead to drive business growth for Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT). This external facing leader will represent AECOM with TxDOT and be responsible for statewide business development, strategy, and relationship across TxDOT’s Central Office and districts and divisions. The key goal is expanding our presence and winning new and repeat business for all of AECOM’s service offerings. This role requires a deep understanding of TxDOT as well as Texas transportation policies, procedures, and regulations.
This position is expected to begin immediately.
Job Summary/Responsibilities
With a 75-year legacy in Texas, AECOM maintains a strong TxDOT presence with offices in major markets across the state, including Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, El Paso, and other key locations. AECOM’s 480 transportation professionals in Texas have supported TxDOT and municipal clients for many decades. Our talented teams combine local knowledge with the resources of a global infrastructure consulting firm, enabling us to deliver planning, environmental, engineering, program management, and construction-phase services throughout the state. Our intent with this role is to build on this depth of experience to grow and expand our support to TxDOT.
The Business Development lead will need to be a growth minded leader who can work collaboratively with other senior leaders in Transportation and other Business Lines to drive strategic planning, business development, sales & marketing, opportunity identification, capture management, and relationship building.  The candidate should be able to demonstrate knowledge of the engineering and construction industry, develop knowledge of the company, and help recruit as we expand our presence.
The responsibilities of this position may include, but are not limited to:
- Fully accountable for business development activities with TxDOT in collaboration with leaders across the AECOM Texas business.
- Represent AECOM and serve a point of contact with TxDOT Leadership.
- Manage the successful delivery of projects by aligning AECOM’s local and global resources and ensuring resources adhere to local transportation regulations, safety standards, and contractual obligations.
- Serve as a Principal-in-Charge on larger projects to provide executive oversight on the project's overall success, client relationship, financial performance and high-level risk management.
- Monitor the Department's needs and trends within the transportation industry, providing insights and recommendations for strategic initiatives.
- Identify opportunities for expanding the scope of services offered to the Department and collaborate with pursuit teams to develop proposals.
- Coordinate with technical teams to ensure that solutions align with the Department's goals and regulatory requirements.
- Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for AECOM leadership highlighting project status, key account performance metrics, and areas for improvement.
- Maintain a high profile with TxDOT and transportation industry.  Attend conferences and workshops to strengthen existing TxDOT relationships and establish new TxDOT relationships.
- Has a keen understanding of industry trends and market drivers.
- Provides leadership in recruiting, training, and retaining top talent for TxDOT opportunities and projects.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
- Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and more.
- Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on transportation projects that enhance public infrastructure and safety.
- Professional development opportunities to stay updated on changing government regulations and industry trends.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment that values innovation and teamwork.
Minimum Requirements
- BA/BS + 12 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with and knowledge of TxDOT standards, policies, regulations, and procedures within a government context.
- Experience in business development and strong existing relationships with TxDOT.
- Existing relationships within the transportation community in Texas, and active involvement in relevant professional organizations
- Team-oriented and able to work in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
- Strong understanding of best practices in capture process for professional services
- This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship.

- Be an active partner to leaders of AECOM’s business in Singapore in the development and implementation of strategic marketing and communications plans and initiatives that strengthen AECOM’s profile targeted in market sectors and client groups e.g. Transportation, Water, Environment and pre-position AECOM to win targeted opportunities .
- Develop and lead account-based marketing strategies and campaigns that enhance AECOM’s profile with existing and prospective clients, leveraging multiple channels, both online and offline, incorporating thought leadership as a core element and client-focused activities.
- Work closely with the wider marketing and business development team to provide marketing support for client development, pre-positioning and proposal support for priority pursuits.
- Manage the development and maintenance of marketing collaterals in line with strategic marketing priorities.
- Manage internal communication activities including development of key leadership messages and employee communications, townhalls, in collaboration with various stakeholders.
- Strategic or account-based marketing experience, preferably in professional services firms or in B2B roles
- Ability to connect and work with key stakeholders at all levels within the business
- Self-starter; able to initiate plans and work with minimal supervision
- Ability to drive the development of content, such as thought leadership materials that support strategic marketing campaigns
- Familiarity with digital tools and platforms such as AI, social media and websites.
- Experience in bids & proposals support is an advantage
- Skills in coordinating events
- A relevant degree in areas such as business administration, communications, economics, journalism
- Minimum 5-8 years working experience

jobs.title: Defence Growth Director – Canberra
jobs.description:
Open doors. Build relationships. Grow AECOM's Defence business at the heart of it all.
The Opportunity
AECOM is looking for a Defence Growth Director to lead our client engagement, market positioning and pursuit strategy across Canberra's Defence and national security landscape.
This is a rare opportunity for someone who has walked the halls of Defence whether in uniform or alongside it to turn that network, credibility and market insight into real growth for a global infrastructure leader. You'll be the face of AECOM to Defence decision-makers across the Department, Defence, Intelligence Agencies and our OEM partners, opening doors that only genuine relationships and trust can open.
If you're a veteran, ex-Navy, ex-Army, ex-Air Force or someone who has spent your career embedded in Defence and built a strong network across it , this role is built for you. We're not looking for someone who can learn Defence. We're looking for someone who already is Defence, and who's ready to bring that experience into a commercial growth role with real influence and real reward.
What You'll Do
Lead client engagement with key Defence decision-makers, including
- DoD (SEG, NSSG & DDA), AUKUS (ASA, ANI & SEG) and Defence OEMs and primes based in and around Canberra.
- Maintain deep market knowledge of the Canberra Defence landscape AUKUS, capability acquisition and sustainment programs, and National Defence Strategy priorities to shape pursuit and capture strategy.
- Partner with the Account Director, Sector Directors and Strategic Pursuit Managers to secure Enterprise Critical Pursuits (ECPs) and Tier 2 pursuits tied to national Defence growth priorities.
- Represent AECOM at Defence industry forums, conferences and community events be the trusted, familiar face in the room.
- Feed client insight and delivery learnings back into pursuit strategy, sharpening how AECOM shows up for Defence clients.
- Apply best-practice capture processes tailored to Defence procurement go/no-go decisions, pre-positioning, capture planning, proposals, security/probity requirements, risk and governance
- Collaborate globally , working with AECOM's US and UK Defence teams to bring the best of AECOM to AUKUS opportunities and leverage global OEM relationships
What You'll Bring
- A strong, established network across Australian Defence decision-makers, primes, OEMs, and the broader Defence community in Canberra.
- Ideally, a background in the Australian Defence Force (Navy, Army or Air Force) , or significant experience working alongside Defence in a civilian capacity.
- Credibility that opens doors the ability to walk into a room as a trusted advisor, not a vendor.
- Commercial acumen and the strategic mindset to translate relationships and market knowledge into bookings, pursuits and revenue growth.
- The influence, communication skill and integrity to represent AECOM as a  industry leader , someone clients call first.
- Australian citizenship and eligibility for an Australian Government security clearance preferred. AUKUS citizenship and security clearance will also be considered

Why AECOM
AECOM is one of the world's trusted infrastructure partners to Defence, playing a central role in Australia's naval shipbuilding, capability acquisition and AUKUS programs. This role sits at the intersection of national priority and personal opportunity the chance to represent a global company, back your own network, and be rewarded for the relationships you've spent a career building.
This isn't a desk job. It's a growth and influence role for someone who already knows how Defence works, who already has the trust of the people who matter, and who's ready to turn that into commercial impact.
Ready to bring your network, your credibility and your Defence experience to a role built around it?
Apply now to become AECOM's next Defence Growth Director in Canberra.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the lands on which we, our clients and our communities live and work around Australia. We pay our respects to their cultures and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging. We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses.  Find out more about our Australian Reconciliation Action Plan here: https://aecom.com/au/our-vision-for-reconciliation/.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

jobs.title: Growth Director - Client & Contractor Partnerships, Transportation, Europe & India
jobs.description:
The Growth Director - Client & Contractor Partnerships, will be responsible for driving growth across all sectors and practices within Transportation across UK&I. This will be in collaboration with Transport Market Sector Directors, the Transportation Strategy & Growth Director, and adjacent Market Sector Directors across Energy, Water and Buildings & Places.
Driving growth will include identifying new market opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, including contractors, overseeing market entry initiatives, and guiding the business toward sustainable and profitable expansion. The role demands strong industry expertise, commercial acumen, sales experience, and leadership to shape the long-term direction of the organisation within the evolving transportation landscape.
In this pivotal role, the post holder will collaboratively, define and execute the sales strategy, build strong client relationships, position the business to win what matters and extend our profile and brand whilst ensuring alignment with the organisation’s overall business objectives.
Business Development & Positioning
- Build strong, long term, relationships with clients across the Transportation market, particularly focused on those with holistic transport requirements for example Department for Transport, Combined Authorities and devolved nations.
- Develop client understanding to support the forming and promotion of strategic partnerships with other organisations including contractors
- Work with clients to support their development of long-term transport solutions that support their overall outcome objectives.
- Position AECOM to be able to shape client thinking
- Position the organisation as a thought leader in our markets

Market Intelligence & Investment Development
- Conduct competitive and market analysis to refine propositions and identify new revenue streams
- Develop investment proposals that provide AECOM with long term growth opportunity
- Provide advice to the business on where future revenue streams will develop and areas where there is reduced opportunity for growth

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Support pipeline analysis to help ensure the Transportation end market has an appropriate pipeline of opportunities to deliver its Business Plan targets with respect to Net Service Revenue and Gross Margin
- Work closely with Strategy & Growth, Market Sectors, Practices, and Marcomms teams to ensure client solutions are feasible and aligned with internal capabilities
- Support the development of effective relationships with internal stakeholders which promotes a culture of success for the wider AECOM business
- Work in full collaboration with Market Sector Directors and Strategy & Growth to lead the directions of the markets and opportunities in the pipeline.
- Work in full collaboration with the regional Contractor Partnerships lead to ensure the right strategic partnerships for success
- Engage with Country Managers across Europe and how closer collaboration can drive growth in their markets
- Engage with the Transportation Global Business Line to ensure the best of AECOM’s global offer and experience is brought to our clients.

Client Account Management (CAM)
- Support and drive development of a world class CAM program within AECOM’s EUR&I Region.
- Working with Client Account Managers and local teams to build consistent and deep relationships with those clients and supply chains, particularly where solutions are not yet defined
- Providing leadership of CAMs within the Transport business and supporting the development of our CAM professionals as well as leadership of rigorous account goal setting and reviews

Performance Management & Reporting
- Analyse pipeline data and provide regular reports to senior management on outlook and market conditions.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the sales process, tools, and client engagement approach.

Industry Events
- Represent AECOM at agreed industry events and with agreed industry bodies.
- Significant experience in business development and work winning
- Minimum 15+ years in business development or growth strategy, leadership roles.
- Proven track record of revenue generation, position development and leading strategic partnerships with other organisations
- Deep knowledge of the Transportation market in UK&I specifically in Rail
- Strong network within the Transportation Sector in UK&I with both Rail Clients and Tier 1 and 2 Contractors
- Experience with public sector procurement including framework agreements
- Excellent project management and communication skills
- Demonstrable record in the preparation, coordination, and delivery of successful client engagement or growth initiatives
- Proven track record of successfully driving and executing strategic plans across complex multi-disciplinary teams
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate at all organisational levels
- Strategic and analytical mindset with a focus on driving results
- Excellent communication and presentation abilities
- Knowledge of Industry dynamics and trends in Europe & India related to Transportation
Preferred Qualifications
- Degree preferred but not essential
- Member of recognised professional body relative to our core markets
- International market development or delivery experience preferred

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

jobs.description:

- Providing leadership of CAMs within the Transport business and supporting the development of our CAM professionals as well as leadership of rigorous account goal setting and reviews

- Analyse pipeline data and provide regular reports to senior management on outlook and market conditions.

- Deep knowledge of the Transportation market in UK&I specifically in Rail
- Strong network within the Transportation Sector in UK&I with both Rail Clients and Tier 1 and 2 Contractors

- Excellent project management and communication skills

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Start here. Grow here.
At AECOM, we are currently recruiting for a Senior Risk Manager to join in our Dublin office.
The Senior Risk Manager  will be required to attend site three days per week and two days per week will be remote working.
The Senior Risk Manager provides leadership in the delivery of risk management services across complex capital projects within a consulting environment. The role leads the identification, assessment, and management of project risks, while offering expert guidance to clients and project teams to ensure risks are proactively and effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.
Here’s what you’ll do:
Your day to day will include but not be limited to the following tasks and responsibilities:
- Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of project and programme-level risk management processes aligned with client requirements and industry best practice.

- Proactively identify, assess, and manage a wide range of project risks, including financial, commercial, operational, schedule, and delivery risks.

- Plan and facilitate risk identification workshops, risk reviews, and assurance sessions with senior internal and external stakeholders.

- Develop, maintain, and assure high-quality risk registers and RAID logs, ensuring risks are clearly articulated, appropriately scored, and effectively tracked.

- Undertake and oversee qualitative and quantitative risk analysis, including risk modelling, and provide clear interpretation of results to inform decision-making.

- Work closely with project controls, cost, planning, and commercial teams to ensure risk outputs are fully integrated into forecasts, schedules, and performance reporting.

- Monitor and report on risk exposure, trends, emerging risks, and mitigation effectiveness, providing concise, actionable insights to clients and leadership teams.

- Support and challenge project teams in the development and implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.

- Ensure risk data is accurate, current, and reflective of the project’s evolving risk profile.

- Provide expert risk management advice, coaching, and mentoring to project teams and junior risk practitioners.

- Contribute to the development of organisational risk capability, standards, tools, and best practices within the consulting business.
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
As the successful candidate, you will have experience working within our aviation markets along with having the following qualifications and experience:
- Typically 8+ years’ experience delivering risk management and/or project controls within complex capital projects.

- Strong experience operating in a consulting or client-facing environment, with a proven ability to build trusted relationships.

- Demonstrated expertise in qualitative and quantitative risk analysis, including risk modelling and scenario analysis.

- Advanced hands-on experience using industry-standard risk management and modelling tools.

- Proven experience working with multidisciplinary project teams, including cost, planning, commercial, and delivery functions.

- Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

- Professional qualifications in risk management, project management, or related disciplines (e.g. APM, PMI, IRM) are desirable.
